official_measurement_examples.name: Article 4 area collection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data reported 7,152 Article 4 direction areas from 111 providers with collector activity on 24 July 2026; national coverage is still a developing collection rather than proof of complete local coverage.

official_measurement_examples.name: Direction collection
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data reported 3,167 Article 4 directions from 101 providers on 21 July 2026 and notes that some MHCLG-created data is still being replaced by authoritative sources.

official_measurement_examples.name: Rule dataset limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Article 4 direction rule dataset currently has no populated rule records, so a mapped area alone cannot reveal exactly which permitted development rights have been withdrawn.

official_measurement_examples.name: Prior approval distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Some permitted development rights require prior approval for specified matters; prior approval is not the same thing as a full planning permission application.

official_measurement_examples.name: Other regimes remain
official_measurement_examples.fact: Permitted development rights do not override other permission, regulation or consent regimes, so PDR eligibility is not total development clearance.

official_measurement_examples.name: Article 4 scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: An Article 4 direction withdraws specified permitted development rights in a defined area and does not create a blanket prohibition on all development.

official_measurement_examples.name: Case-specific wording
official_measurement_examples.fact: The restrictions imposed by an Article 4 direction or planning condition vary case by case and the exact wording must be checked before concluding whether planning permission is required.

official_measurement_examples.name: Experimental category data
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data's permitted-development-right categories are experimental support data; historical or category entries must not substitute for checking the current GPDO and local direction wording.

core_rules: Article 4 area intersection is not a blanket development prohibition
exact Article 4 direction wording determines which rights are withdrawn
Article 4 direction geometry is distinct from direction legal instrument
direction legal instrument is distinct from rule/category data
empty rule dataset must not be treated as no restrictions
permitted development right eligibility is proposal-specific
prior approval is distinct from full planning permission
prior approval requirement is not automatic refusal
PDR does not override other consent regimes
planning conditions can separately remove permitted development rights
local Article 4 coverage may be incomplete in national collection
historic PDR category data must retain legislation date/version
Article 4 evidence does not determine land ownership
PDR eligibility does not reserve development capacity
no parcel PDR clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
